params.name: messageId
params.description: The message ID of the teleporter message.

items.docs:
**[Deprecated]** Gets a teleporter message by message ID.

⚠️ **This operation will be removed in a future release.  Please use /v1/icm/messages/:messageId endpoint instead** .

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

params.name: sourceBlockchainId
params.description: The base58 encoded blockchain ID or evm chain ID of the source chain that the teleporter message was sent from.

params.name: destinationBlockchainId
params.description: The base58 encoded blockchain ID or evm chain ID of the destination chain that the teleporter message was sent to.

params.name: blockchainId
params.description: The base58 encoded blockchain ID of either source or destination chain that one teleporter message interacts with.

params.name: to
params.description: The address of the recipient of the teleporter message.

params.name: from
params.description: The address of the sender of the teleporter message.
